---
title: "PIMCO’s Bill Gross: The End is Nigh!"
date: "2006-01-17"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

PIMCO’s Bill Gross, quoted in a [Barron’s](http://online.barrons.com/public/search/results.html "Barron’s") cover story, keeping the [doomsday cult](../2005/contrarian_optimism_versus_the_doomsday_cult_a_fund_managers_view.qmd "doomsday cult") alive:

*U.S. investors should accelerate their exposure to non-dollar stocks, because the dollar as a currency is doomed.*

So very 2005.
